timeScaleCompatibilityContract.accepted: All constraints have exactly the same non-empty timeScaleAuthority and timeScaleVersion
timeScaleCompatibilityContract.conversion: Rejected until a separately versioned authoritative boundary-reevaluation contract is implemented
timeScaleCompatibilityContract.prohibition: No silent mixing, label replacement or numeric identity assumption across scale versions

endpointComparisonContract.evidenceResolutionRule: recorded for provenance but never added to numeric tolerance; geological uncertainty must enter through explicit uncertainty envelopes
